title: Precursor-of-Anomaly Detection for Irregular Time Series

problem.claim: Detect future anomalies before they occur in time series.

gap.claim: Detecting future anomalies before they occur remains unexplored.

contributions.claim: Introduces Precursor-of-Anomaly detection, which detects future anomalies before they happen.
Presents a neural controlled differential equation-based neural network and a multi-task learning algorithm for anomaly and Precursor-of-Anomaly detection.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors explicitly describe Precursor-of-Anomaly detection as a novel type of anomaly detection.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments with 17 baselines and 3 datasets, including regular and irregular time series, reportedly show that the presented method outperforms the baselines in almost all cases.
Ablation studies reportedly indicate that multitasking training significantly improves overall performance for both anomaly and Precursor-of-Anomaly detection.

narrative_sequence.summary: Anomaly detection targets unexpected patterns or data points and is relevant to several real-world applications.
Future-anomaly detection before occurrence is identified as an unexplored area.
The paper defines Precursor-of-Anomaly detection as detecting future anomalies before they happen.
A neural controlled differential equation-based network and multi-task learning algorithm are proposed.
Experiments and ablations report broad baseline improvements and benefits from multitask training.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the datasets, baselines, evaluation metrics, or performance values.
The abstract does not describe the anomaly or precursor labels, prediction horizon, or detection timing.
